title: meeting-recorder
subHeroTitle: Stop losing what gets decided in meetings.
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings — then automatically suggests the tasks and follow-ups that came out of them. You review, approve, and move on.

sections.title: Record any meeting, straight from your browser
sections.desc: No app to install, no third-party tools. Hit record, and KeilHQ captures everything. Pause, mute, and stop controls are always one click away.

gridItems.title: One-click browser recording
gridItems.desc: Start recording any meeting directly from KeilHQ — no installs, no plugins, no setup.

gridItems.title: Full recording controls
gridItems.desc: Mute, pause, resume, or stop at any time. A live timer keeps you aware of how long you've been recording.

gridItems.title: Instant cloud storage
gridItems.desc: Recordings upload automatically the moment you stop. They're ready for transcription before you've closed the window.

sections.title: Know who said what, and when
sections.desc: The transcript labels each speaker separately so you can follow the conversation by person, not just by time. Search for any keyword and jump straight to that moment.

gridItems.title: Speaker-by-speaker transcript
gridItems.desc: Every line of the transcript is labelled by speaker. Instantly see who said what, and click to isolate one person's contributions.

gridItems.title: Search any moment
gridItems.desc: Type any word or topic and jump to every place it was mentioned. Never scrub through audio again.

gridItems.title: Multiple languages
gridItems.desc: KeilHQ detects the language automatically and transcribes in it — across a wide range of global and regional languages.

gridItems.title: Audio playback
gridItems.desc: Listen back at your own pace with speed controls, waveform scrubbing, and 10-second skip buttons.

sections.title: Meeting notes that write themselves
sections.desc: When the recording ends, KeilHQ generates a structured summary — the main topics discussed, decisions made, and open questions still on the table.

gridItems.title: Executive summary
gridItems.desc: A clear, concise overview of what the meeting covered — ready to share with anyone who wasn't in the room.

gridItems.title: Decisions made
gridItems.desc: A bulleted list of everything the team agreed on, so there's no debate later about what was actually decided.

gridItems.title: Open questions and risks
gridItems.desc: Anything left unresolved gets flagged automatically — so follow-ups don't fall through the cracks.

gridItems.title: One-click export
gridItems.desc: Copy clean meeting notes to share anywhere, or save them directly as a document in your workspace.

sections.title: Turn meeting decisions into real work, automatically
sections.desc: KeilHQ reads through the meeting and proposes the tasks, updates, and follow-ups that came out of it. You review each suggestion and approve or edit before anything gets created.

gridItems.title: Automatic task proposals
gridItems.desc: KeilHQ identifies action items from the meeting and proposes them as tasks — with owners, priorities, and context already filled in.

gridItems.title: CRM and pipeline updates
gridItems.desc: Sales calls automatically surface deal updates, contact changes, and pipeline movements to review and approve.

gridItems.title: You approve everything
gridItems.desc: Nothing gets created without your sign-off. Review each proposal, edit if needed, then approve or dismiss.

sections.title: Save meeting notes straight into your workspace
sections.desc: Turn any meeting summary into a formatted document with one click — saved directly into Motion Docs and synced to Notion if you use it.

gridItems.title: Save to Motion Docs
gridItems.desc: One click turns your meeting summary into a formatted, organized document saved directly in your workspace.

gridItems.title: Notion sync
gridItems.desc: If your team uses Notion, meeting notes sync there automatically — no copy-pasting between tools.

capabilitiesTitle: Every meeting turns into structured, actionable output.
capabilitiesDesc: Record, transcribe, summarize, and act on meetings — all inside the same workspace where your work lives.
checklistTitle: What a meeting should actually produce
checklistDesc: KeilHQ makes sure important decisions, action items, and context from every meeting get captured and turned into real work.
checklistItems: Record any meeting from your browser — no installs, no third-party tools, just one click to start.
Get a full transcript with each speaker labelled separately, so you always know who said what.
Receive a structured summary automatically — main topics, decisions made, and open questions flagged.
AI reads through the meeting and proposes tasks and follow-ups. You review and approve before anything is created.
Save meeting notes directly into your workspace as a document, or sync them to Notion if you use it.
Access any past recording from anywhere in KeilHQ — linked to the task, project, or calendar event it belongs to.
